lines: Phew~ By the way, where are you heading, Fuma-chan?
Anywhere is fine. Look for any room that might have a terminal in it.
It looks like there is a network set up specifically for this base. We should be able to infiltrate that network easily from any terminal on the base.
So that's what you meant. Not sure Hebiko understands though!
Fuma-chan, you're good with this kind of stuff, huh. You also helped the granny at Inageya set up her internet too, didn't you?
H-Hey!! Enemies coming from up ahead!!
Shikanosuke, who had been paying attention to his electric sonar, warned us just before heavily armed UFS soldiers appeared and readied their guns.
